verdicts.tldr: vm/qfile never answers an empty body: an absent package errors and a stored one always holds a file
verdicts.details: ListFiles does carry the same strings.Split shape as ListPaths, but the two queries differ in what an empty result looks like. vm/qpaths returns a body with no error for a prefix that matches nothing, which is why the diff and GetPathsListView both guard paths[0] == ""; vm/qfile's listing branch returns an error for an absent path (keeper.go:1943-1944, wrapped as "is not available" and mapped to ErrClientPackageNotFound at client.go:225-226), so the only way to reach an empty body is a live mem package with zero files. AddPackage refuses exactly that (keeper.go:788-794, "package has no production .gno files"), so files is never []string{""} at GetSourceView or GetDirectoryView and neither the blank directory entry nor the "empty filename given" follow-on can occur. The ListPaths guard the diff adds is therefore not a missed sibling. Fix: none — the unguarded len(files) == 0 checks are sound against the query that feeds them.
verdicts.evidence: gno.land/pkg/sdk/vm/keeper.go:1942-1944 `memPkg := store.GetMemPackageAll(dirpath)` / `if memPkg == nil { return "", errors.Wrapf(&InvalidPackageError{}, "package %q is not available", dirpath) }`; keeper.go:788-794 `// Reject packages with no production .gno files` / `return ErrInvalidPackage("package has no production .gno files")`; keeper.go:1946-1951 joins memPkg.Files with "\n", so res is empty only for a zero-file package.
verdicts.refuted_by: gno.land/pkg/sdk/vm/keeper.go:1944 return "", errors.Wrapf(&InvalidPackageError{}, "package %q is not available", dirpath)

verdicts.verify_by: GET /u/moul001:bob against the shared in-memory node and compare the status and body to /u/moul001.
verdicts.tldr: /u/<name>:anything serves the profile page unchanged, so every user page has unbounded duplicate URLs
verdicts.details: weburl.Username() is `return gnoURL.Path[3:]` (url.go:290-296) and never consults the parsed Args, and the post-diff GetUserView body reads Username(), buildContributions, and Realm(ctx, "/r/"+username+"/home", "") — the literal empty args — with no reference to gnourl.Args anywhere between handler_http.go:603 and the UserView return. The gate the diff adds therefore validates the name shape, the length and the registry answer, and then serves the identical 200 for /u/alice:whatever as for /u/alice. A reader who follows such a link sees a real profile at a URL the page itself never produces, and a crawler sees the same page at arbitrarily many addresses. It is pre-existing — the base built the username with strings.TrimPrefix(gnourl.Path, "/u/") and ignored Args the same way — but the diff is the pass that turned /u/ into a validated surface and the args are the one part of the URL it still lets through. Fix: reject a non-empty gnourl.Args in GetUserView with the same 404 as an invalid name, or redirect to the bare /u/<name>.
verdicts.evidence: gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/weburl/url.go:290-296 `func (gnoURL GnoURL) Username() string { if !gnoURL.IsUser() { return "" }; return gnoURL.Path[3:] }`; handler_http.go:604 `username := gnourl.Username()` and :617 `h.Client.Realm(ctx, "/r/"+username+"/home", "")` — no Args read on any path through the function. Finder's probe against the shared in-memory node agrees: `PROBE /u/moul001:bob -> 200`, `PROBE /u/moul001 -> 200`, both rendering `Gnome moul001`.
